assets.title: Send auth email with Resend
assets.content:
Subject: Send auth email with Resend
Preview text: Evaluate a separate sending platform with clear daily limits.

Give auth email a separate sending path

Hi there,

Resend is now available as a separate platform for sending personalized, event-driven transactional email from your own verified domain.

If a hosted auth provider’s built-in sender constrains signup confirmations, password resets, invitations, or OTPs, you can evaluate Resend independently using a Resend API key.

The limits are explicit: the Free plan allows 100 emails per day. Pro, Scale, and Enterprise plans have no daily email limit, so moving to a paid plan does not exchange one daily cap for another.

Resend does not change the auth platform’s own rate-limit setting. After configuring a separate sender, that setting still needs to be adjusted in the platform’s dashboard.

Create a free account to begin setup with your verified domain and API key.

Sign up for free →

- the Resend team

assets.title: Give auth email its own route
assets.content:
Subject: Give auth email its own route
Preview text: Test one transactional flow through SMTP or an official SDK.

Route auth email through Resend

Hi there,

Resend gives you a separate route for transactional email through SMTP or an official SDK. Your auth platform can handle authentication without its built-in sender remaining the only route for confirmations, OTPs, magic links, or invites.

When a built-in sender reaches its limit, retrying or upgrading the platform plan does not replace that sender. Custom SMTP and the platform’s separate rate-limit settings still need to be configured where applicable.

You can evaluate Resend without moving every email flow. Create an account, verify your domain, obtain an API key, and test one auth-critical message through SMTP or the SDK for your stack.

The Free plan has a 100-email daily limit. Pro, Scale, and Enterprise plans have no daily sending limit, giving you a defined starting point before deciding whether to adopt Resend more broadly.

Sign up for free →

- the Resend team
